references.text: The building of the altar by the Jordan that led to conflict between the tribes
The altar was to be a witness between the tribes that they belong to the Lord
The heap of stones as a witness between Jacob and Laban, a similar concept of a physical monument serving as a witness
Joshua set up a stone as a witness to the covenant between God and Israel
The confession that the Lord is God, the same theological declaration
The people's confession that the Lord is God after Elijah's sacrifice on Mount Carmel
